analysis:
Integration pass over all 30 units. The PR is mostly docs, tests and local ProviderCore bookkeeping. It adds selected-model residency recovery, a drain-without-ack path, bounded 15 s shutdown unloads, and new diagnostic daemon-state fields. I found no concrete regression against the threat model. I did not see the core implementations.

Verified from replayed patches:
- ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift:207 cancels the in-flight recovery attempt in enterAddonHold. This tightens TB-012/T-059/A-018.
- ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:213 only records noteSelectedModelUnloaded after a successful victim unload.
- ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift:22 marks a recovery attempt as busy (preload), which is conservative.
- ProviderLoop+ModelSwitch.swift:143 adds attempt==nil to the settle predicate, a minor liveness coupling.
- ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift: a drain with the coordinator down waits up to 10 s and then completes without an acknowledgement. It still requires lifecycleRemaining==0, nativeOwnersDrained and the App Attest worker retirement gate. T-053 is unaffected. The claim that disconnect already cancelled accepted work is unverified, since the coordinator client code was not supplied.
- StartupShutdown.swift: the shutdown unload is bounded at 15 s per slot and stuck slots are left to process exit (T-028, T-029). It leaves no data longer than the process lives.
- DaemonState adds optional enabled-models and recovery fields. They carry model IDs and blocker text only, no prompts, keys or tokens, and decode with decodeIfPresent.
- Test seams are internal and nil by default.

Unverified because the files were not supplied, in ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift and ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift:
- Whether recovery loads honor servingDrain/addonHoldActive on every path other than enterAddonHold.
- Whether the load keeps the weight-hash and memory-admission checks (T-012, T-027).
- Whether eviction cannot touch an in-flight model.
- Whether makeAllDue after each unload cannot cause load churn.
- What unloadAllModelsForShutdown does with KV and cache cleanup (T-041).
- Whether blocker strings are sanitized.

The changelog's adoption-release policy is marked pending owner review. The prefix-cache posture (T-041) is unchanged.
